name: delete_files
title: Delete files and folders
description: Delete authorized absolute Windows files and empty directories without persisting operation records. An ordinary file with a Windows reserved final name is permanently deleted after identity checks without using the bin; dry-run reports would_permanently_delete. Reserved-name directories and links are rejected. Other items normally go to the Windows Recycle Bin; if Windows reports a file or folder too large for the bin and its original identity is confirmed, Prunlet attempts permanent deletion. Confirmed removal returns permanently_deleted; an uncertain attempt returns ambiguous. On a volume whose immediate-delete setting is confirmed (the bin is unavailable), an item may also be permanently deleted after the same identity checks; its status is permanently_deleted, never recycled. Other recycling failures never trigger permanent deletion. Dry-run cannot predict an ordinary item's bin-size outcome. Ambiguous results require inspecting the source and Windows Recycle Bin without resending deletion. Set recursive=true for folder contents. Metadata and legacy recovery storage stay protected. Hard links retain shared content. Does not expand wildcards or follow link targets.

dryRun.description: Inspect without changing files or directories.

recursive.description: Explicitly include all files and subdirectories of directory targets. Defaults to false.

action.description: Omit for synchronous deletion. Enqueue returns a queued job and accepts paths and recursive, but not dryRun. Status and cancel require jobId only. Cancel is allowed only while waiting and is refused after deletion starts.

jobId.description: Queued deletion job identifier, required only with action=status or cancel.

name: delete_registry
title: Back up and delete a registry key or value
description: Delete an explicitly authorized local HKCU/HKLM/HKU key or literal value in required view 32 or 64. Omit valueName for a key; empty string selects the default value. Key trees require recursive=true. Full key Owner/Group/DACL/SACL backup requires SeSecurityPrivilege; no automatic elevation or nontransactional fallback. Recovery shares the configured retention and capacity budget. Host approvals and policies still apply.

valueName.description: Literal value name; empty string selects the default value. Omit to delete the key.

accessMode.description: Explicit backupRestore enables effective-token backup/restore privileges to bypass ordinary ACL access checks. Only view 64 in a 64-bit Windows process is supported. Default normal; never selected automatically.

name: restore_registry
title: Restore a registry deletion operation
description: Restore a retained registry operation by operationId in its recorded view. Refuse existing destinations, including an empty existing default value. Restore consumes recovery data after a successful transaction. Insufficient owner/SACL permissions or ambiguous commit state preserve recovery data and do not fall back.

accessMode.description: Choose backupRestore explicitly for this restoration; only recorded view 64 in a 64-bit Windows process is supported. The deletion mode is not remembered.

name: reconcile_registry
title: Inspect a registry operation outcome
description: Read retained receipts for the original operationId after a disconnected native registry request. Does not repeat deletion or restore and does not infer an unconfirmed transaction outcome.

name: list_operations
title: List registry recovery operations
description: List registry operation ids available in the configured recovery directory. File and folder deletions have no Prunlet operation records.
